summary: Raise billing payment-submit retry ceiling and align the runbook
description: Payments occasionally fail under transient downstream errors. Apply the retry ceiling from ADR-014 (the authoritative decision) and make the runbook match the code. Do NOT change which status codes are retry-safe.
acceptance_criteria: Retry ceiling matches ADR-014 (the authoritative decision).
The runbook no longer contradicts the code.
No change to retry-safe status codes (429/502/503/504).
